"""Run frozen, local production-boundary cases; exit status is the metric."""
import hashlib, json, platform, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
checks = {
    "timing": ("test_stack_runner.py", "test_direct_workflow_payload_cannot_hide_timing"),
    "eval-concurrency": ("test_evalify.py", "test_concurrent_runs_reserve_receipt_and_output_before_dispatch"),
    "constrain-context": ("test_constrain.py", "test_identical_bodies_with_distinct_fixtures_or_decorators_are_not_proven_duplicates"),
    "hill-interval": ("test_hill_climb.py", "test_large_sample_intervals_do_not_understate_student_t_uncertainty"),
    "learn-evolution": ("test_skill_evolution.py", "test_all_requested_authored_suites_can_prepare_for_evolution"),
}
guards = {
    "timing": ("test_stack_runner.py", "test_runner_records_a_real_deadline_without_recording_payload"),
    "eval-concurrency": ("test_evalify.py", "test_runner_results_are_bounded_retained_and_fail_closed"),
    "constrain-context": ("test_constrain.py", "test_duplicate_renamed_tests_and_budget_growth_block_without_automatic_baseline"),
    "hill-interval": ("test_hill_climb.py", "test_paired_gain_and_untouched_claim_boundary"),
    "learn-evolution": ("test_skill_evolution.py", "test_evolution_scopes_memory_and_gates_without_global_config"),
}
name, label = sys.argv[1:]
if name not in checks or not label.replace("-", "").isalnum():
    raise SystemExit("invalid name or label")
result = []
for kind, source in (("target", checks[name]), ("guard", guards[name])):
    file, test = source
    for rep in range(3):
        started = time.monotonic()
        command = [sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", file, "-k", test]
        try:
            run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=40)
            output = run.stdout + run.stderr
            status = run.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            output = str(error)
            status = 124
        out = here / (label + "-" + name + "-" + kind + "-" + str(rep) + ".log")
        out.write_text(output)
        result.append({"check": name, "kind": kind, "rep": rep, "exit": status,
            "elapsed_ms": round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000, 3),
            "test_sha256": hashlib.sha256((root / "tests" / file).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "log": out.name, "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(here / (label + "-" + name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(name, label, [(row["kind"], row["exit"]) for row in result])
